title: Dr. Ali Kafour

[[Image:DrAliKafour.png|right|160px]]
'''Dr. Ali Kafour''' is an [[ally]]. He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[The Unnamable]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Horror check|Horror]]
*+2 [[Spell]]

Search the [[Unique item]] deck, taking the first [[tome]] you find.

==Mythos Source==
Dr. Ali Kafour appears in the Masks of Nyarlathotep campaign for Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.
